exposure: Type of delivery (Normal Vaginal Delivery vs. Cesarean Section)
receiving adequate support during labor and delivery
history of attending childbirth education classes
giving birth in a private hospital
outcome: Childbirth experience (measured by the Childbirth Experience Questionnaire (CEQ) score)
cohort: 300 primiparous women (150 with NVD and 150 with CS) with a mean age of 27.85 years, referring to comprehensive health centers in Rasht City, Iran.
finding: Primiparous women who underwent Cesarean section in Rasht City reported a significantly better childbirth experience compared to those with normal vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The mean total Childbirth Experience Questionnaire score was significantly higher in primiparous women with Cesarean section than in those with normal vaginal delivery (P=0.001).
cross-section timing: N/A (Data was collected in 2022, but the timing relative to birth (e.g., postpartum week) is not specified.)
